//: Graphite · the LIGHT MONOCHROME theme: grey ink on near-white paper, with ONE hue.
//1: THE source for every shell surface (quickshell/: bar, launcher, OSD, power
//2: menu). No upstream palette — every role is lifted from the wallpaper, an ink
//3: sketch of a figure in tactical gear aiming a rifle: the paper, its darkened
//4: edges, the pencil hatching, the heavy ink of the barrel, and the single
//5: violet EYE. `tokens` names each role after what it is in the picture so the
//6: mapping stays traceable. theme.lua still owns WINDOW chrome (gaps, border,
//8: One-accent rule: everything is grey ink on paper and exactly one hue exists,
//9: the violet, which marks THE THING YOU ACT ON — readouts, the launcher,
//10: hovered things. The frame is INK (near-black), not a color: islands, window
//11: borders and notification rims are drawn lines. No readoutBright on purpose:
//12: the active workspace is then solid `frame`, a black pill with the digit in
//13: `ground`, instead of an emissive lozenge (see modules/Workspaces.qml).
name: graphite
//tokens: What in the picture -> role, so a palette bump stays traceable. warn/ok/urgent are NOT in the picture (it has one hue); they are named for the lights the gear would carry if the sketch were colored, and appear only as state.
//print: Derived inks the terminal-side files share. The state colors are tuned as fills and glyphs on the bar, not as body text, so each has a printed form: brass ink #8f5f1a is `warn` printed (5.0:1 on sheet), tritium ink #3f7049 is `ok` printed (5.3:1), laser ink #ad3d51 is `urgent` printed (5.4:1). The violet needs no ink: `readout` already reads at 5.2:1. The hueless ANSI slots are two pencil weights between `frame` and `dim`: hard pencil #5c5054 (7.0:1) and soft pencil #74676b (4.9:1).
//effects: Flat sketch: no glow (ink does not emit), no scanlines (paper has no raster).
//bar: Bar identity. Paper islands: near-opaque sheet, a 1px ink rim at 70%, 8px corners. Opaque-ish on purpose — a grey sketch frosted through a light fill just goes grey, so the fill is paper and the drawing stays outside it.
//launcher: Launcher identity: a 1px violet rim around a paper sheet (the one surface drawn in the hue — you act on it), 10px window, 6px input + rows.
//osd: OSD identity: a full pill with a 1px ink rim, violet track.
//session: Power-menu identity: paper tiles with 10px corners and a 1px ink edge at 70%, over a light scrim.
//wallpaper: Shared by hyprlock.conf (brightness) and sddm/Main.qml (1 - brightness scrim). 0.92, not 0.55: the picture is near-white paper, and the dark themes' dim would turn it to slate — the lock and the greeter are read with ink on paper, not cream on dusk.
